Item:     PA-4013
Category: pricing
Rules:    rubric v1, profile pricing v1
State:    screened_out

Knockout gates
  FAIL  Public source           The governing source is not a statute, a regulation or an official government publication.
  FAIL  Runs in the browser     It needs a backend server.
  FAIL  Private by design       It does not work offline.
  FAIL  One job                 It does more than one job.
  FAIL  Arithmetic, not advice  It renders advice or a legal conclusion.
